issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 02 returns an extra column (Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel) in the SELECT list that is not requested by the problem statement. The problem asks for the names and streets of all Freizeitparks and the names of the respective Gemeinden; it explicitly requires to output exactly the requested data. The template also does not include this extra column. This mismatch between the solution and the problem/template can confuse students about the exact expected output.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql to select only the requested columns: Freizeitpark.name, Freizeitpark.strasse, and Gemeinde.name. Remove Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel from the SELECT list so the solution matches the problem requirement to output exactly the requested data.
